clue.text: Soldier taking r-risk with structure that spells death

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
the stammered spelling asks for a stammered synonym: risk means bet, said with its first letter stuttered

explanation.surface: A soldier gambling his life on a stutter, beside a deadly wooden frame.
explanation.walkthrough: The stutter written into 'r-risk' tells you to stutter its synonym too, giving B-BET.
explanation.definitionFit: A gibbet is a gallows, an upright post from which executed criminals were hung, so its presence meant someone's death.

clue.text: Damage in fruit — there's black stuff

indicators.note: in shows the damage word goes inside the fruit

parts.note: a grape is a fruit
to hit something is to damage it

explanation.surface: Bruised fruit develops black patches.
explanation.definitionFit: Pencil lead is a soft black form of carbon, the dark stuff in pencils.

clue.text: Swimmer crossing river with little energy must get a rest

indicators.note: crossing means going across, so the swimmer's word spans the others

parts.note: a bather is someone swimming
E is the physics symbol for energy, a little bit of the word

explanation.surface: A tired swimmer crossing a river needs a pause.
explanation.definitionFit: A short pause to catch one's breath, a respite.

clue.text: Praise from former sweetheart upset man with backward-looking wife

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the word is reversed

parts.note: in Genesis, Lot's wife looked back at Sodom and became a pillar of salt

explanation.surface: Praise from an old flame who is unhappy about a man with a nostalgic wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backward-looking' sounds like a dig at a conservative wife; it points to the Bible story.
explanation.definitionFit: To laud highly, a formal verb meaning praise.

clue.text: Food aboard ship for breaks

indicators.note: aboard means placed on board, so the food goes inside the ship's letters

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
a tart is a pastry dish, a kind of food

explanation.surface: Meals served on a ship to mark rest periods.
explanation.definitionFit: Dawn breaks or a storm breaks when it begins, so breaks is a verb meaning begins.

clue.text: Awful female manager nastily engaged in heart of battle

indicators.note: engaged in means fighting inside, so the jumbled letters sit within the centre letters
the heart is the centre, so only the middle letters of the word are kept
nastily means the word is treated roughly and its letters jumbled

explanation.surface: A frightful woman boss, spitefully caught up in the thick of combat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awful female' looks like a description of the manager, but the whole phrase is the definition and 'manager' is only fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrewish, overbearing woman, a virago.

clue.text: Power limited in attacks on account of fast-flowing water

indicators.note: limited in means confined within, so P is put inside the other word

parts.note: raids are attacks
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Military strength is held back during assaults because of white water.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretch of river where the current runs swiftly over rocks.

clue.text: Maybe 'staid' could be confused with 'stayed'

indicators.note: confused means mixed up, so the letters of the quoted word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A spelling warning that two similar-sounding words get mixed up.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface looks like a note on homophones, but the quoted word is simply rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Staid is one example of calm and settled, hence 'Maybe': sober, unruffled and dependable.

clue.text: Version of Bible is in another tongue, a new language

parts.note: AV is the Authorised Version of the Bible
est is French for 'is'

explanation.surface: A Bible translation rendered in a foreign tongue, a new language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another tongue' is French here, which supplies EST for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Avestan is the ancient Iranian language in which the Zoroastrian scriptures are written.

clue.text: Bird's extremely blustery experience after sunset

definitions.meaning: a songbird famous for singing at dusk
read whimsically, being out after dark within a fierce storm wind

explanation.surface: A bird's stormy evening.
explanation.definitionFit: A small brown thrush-like songbird celebrated for its rich nocturnal song.

clue.text: Bit of food that is producing disease in sheep

parts.note: a scrap is a small leftover bit of food
i.e. abbreviates id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A morsel of food that causes illness in sheep.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrapie is a fatal brain disorder of sheep and goats, related to mad cow disease.

clue.text: Adversely affected vehicle having power reduced going into pig

indicators.note: going into means entering, so the pieces sit inside the pig's word

parts.note: a sow is a female pig
a truck is a vehicle

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: able means having the power to do something

explanation.surface: A lorry that has lost power crashes into a pig.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurt or damaged by some event, as in a phrase for a setback that harmed something.

clue.text: Where one may stay very warm — the bowels of hell!

parts.note: very warm means hot

indicators.note: the bowels are a thing's inside, so only the middle letters of the next word are taken

explanation.surface: An exclamation about lodgings so warm they feel like the depths of hell.
explanation.definitionFit: Travellers lodge overnight in such an inn, a place offering rooms for guests.

clue.text: Garden lad laid out adorned with flowers

indicators.note: laid out means arranged afresh, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A garden boy sets out a display decked in flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A garland is a wreath of flowers, so being decked with them means wearing floral wreaths.

clue.text: I notice her at work — someone who figures things out on paper?

definitions.text: someone who figures things out on paper?

indicators.note: at work suggests things being worked over and changed, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone observes a colleague at her job: a desk-bound thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At' looks like part of 'at work', but it belongs in the fodder; only 'work' signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A thinker who deals in abstract ideas rather than practice works problems out on paper, not in the field.

clue.text: Top up Pilsner and he will get drunk

indicators.note: drunk means intoxicated and reeling, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Refill the glass: lager on top and this man will be inebriated.
explanation.definitionFit: To fill again or restore what was used, as when refilling a glass.

clue.text: Cover that will soon be found under a tree?

definitions.text: Cover that will soon be found under a tree?

parts.words: Cover that will soon be found under a tree?
parts.note: the tree is a Christmas tree, and presents are placed beneath it in decorative paper

explanation.definitionFit: Decorative paper used to enclose presents, which are piled beneath the Christmas tree.

clue.text: Not all fishermen had enough fish

indicators.note: Not all says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Anglers have had too many of a catch.
explanation.definitionFit: An oily North American fish of the herring family, used for bait and fishmeal.

clue.text: Extended shed possessed by this writer — building material may have come from here

definitions.text: building material may have come from here

parts.note: extended, as in spread wide, means open
to shed skin is to cast it
what belongs to me, the setter, is mine

explanation.surface: The setter owns an enlarged shed built of quarried stone.
explanation.definitionFit: Stone, gravel and coal are dug from an excavation at the surface rather than from tunnels, a quarry-like pit.

clue.text: Steer clear of explosive wife, wanting escape at the outset

parts.note: ESC is the escape key on a keyboard, placed at the start
HE abbreviates high explosive

explanation.surface: Keep away from a volatile spouse who wants to flee at the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wanting' means needing: the explosive and wife need ESC placed first.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid deliberately, to abstain from something on principle.

clue.text: Cat doctor — one having lots of drugs

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor
a user is someone who takes drugs

explanation.surface: A vet for cats who overprescribes.
explanation.definitionFit: A cat valued for catching rodents, a feline hunter.

clue.text: Delay food that's kept on the menu wanted by everyone

indicators.note: kept means held inside, so the food holds the next piece

parts.note: stew is a dish of food
a dish that is on the menu is 'on', available
all means everyone

explanation.surface: Hold up a dish that stays listed because every diner wants it.
explanation.definitionFit: To obstruct or stall by evasive tactics is a verb sense, as with stalling filibusters in debate.

clue.text: Problem in hospital — bit of a pain

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital
an itch is a mild irritation, a little discomfort

explanation.surface: A setback in a hospital that is a mild nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: A snag or difficulty that interrupts progress, as in 'without a hitch'.

clue.text: Philosopher offering cant, good at heart

indicators.note: at heart means in the middle, so G sits inside the other word

parts.note: to cant is to tilt, as a ship heels

explanation.surface: A thinker who spouts jargon but means well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cant' looks like insincere talk; here it is the tilting sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Georg Hegel was the German idealist thinker of the dialectic.

clue.text: Good person, one in hovel that's unfriendly

indicators.note: in shows the saint and the one are placed inside the hovel

parts.note: a hole is a squalid dwelling, a hovel
ST abbreviates saint, a good person
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A saintly lodger in a slum with a cold welcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Antagonistic and unwelcoming in manner is a direct synonym for unfriendly.

clue.text: Staked money in pay packet — subsequently embarrassed

indicators.note: subsequently means afterwards, so this piece follows the previous one

parts.note: a wage is what comes in a pay packet
an embarrassed person goes red

explanation.surface: Someone bet their wages, then blushed at the loss.
explanation.definitionFit: To bet a sum on an outcome is to put money at stake on it.

clue.text: Quarrel over your esteemed dignitary

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the word for quarrel is read backwards

parts.note: a row is a quarrel
thy is the archaic form of your

explanation.surface: An argument about some important figure of yours.
explanation.definitionFit: A notable or important person, often used of local bigwigs, as in 'the village worthies'.

clue.text: Garment boy wrapped around neck

indicators.note: wrapped around means enclosing, so the boy's word encloses the other

parts.note: a son is a boy
neck in the sense of cheek or impudence is lip

explanation.surface: A boy's clothing wound around his neck.
explanation.definitionFit: A shoe or garment that is pulled on without fastenings, an item of clothing.
